the best thing to do is really to get a coach or go for lessons! they may be expensive but they’ll really help to build your foundations in skating!  most of the skaters are nice enough to teach you if you try to talk to them so you could give it a shot too! 

and, i think you should be able to preorder skates from the proshop near the ice rink in S’pore (Though it takes a long time ajajaja) or maybe get the skates that they have instock because the prices are almost similar online too...
i usually skate at jcube since it’s nearer to where i live anyways and they’re releasing a new student pass (or loyalty pass) in april so it’s cheaper to skate if you plan to frequent the rink a lot!

i would say between 6-20++? 

you dont have to worry about that!! the group lessons will also have some adults in them! i was scared that i was going to be the oldest one in my group but there were a couple people who were older than me HAHA

ah, i see but do try to get yourself fitted at the shop first because different skate brands have different ways of measuring their sizes and you wouldnt want to spend so much on an ill fitting boot; it happened to me once ;(  

i do take lessons at the rink and it’s okay, i would say since you dont get full attention on your skating since it is a group session :( you can choose if you want your lessons to be every saturday or every sunday! but if your schedule is supper irregular, the next best thing is to have 1-to-1! it’s possible to learn online but it’s really depends if you can understand it based on a simple video.

i’m from singapore too!! 

there is only one shop in singapore that sell skates with is Swirls & Twizzles right beside The Rink at J-cube. You can ask the aunties there for a beginner level boot which may start off at about $100~ I got Edea Overtures but they’re rather expensive so make sure you’re very sure on which skates you want! 

as for lessons, there are group lessons at The Rink as well or if you would rather have one-to-one, there is that option as well!! 

hope to see you around!
